text.TITLE: Goleniów → Hoßkirch Blade Route
text.DESC: Route survey for 84.3 m blades from Goleniów to Hoßkirch: routed and checked from open data only, every difficult stretch found by the swept-path model, measured against the laser terrain and point clouds and driven in 3D.
